room kingdomhearts (order 526) done: 25 second-order themes placed in existing kinds (51 placements; 26 rule 0 lines; no bag). A game series sub, its style swapped with r/FinalFantasy for April Fools, that failed at Sora and held a small Keyblade with K H and a heart and a full-sized Keyblade by asking hosts' permission: a leaked reremaster and fake game news, objected to and tested (T3-001, T3-032, T3-095), the moderators' Final Fantasy dress worked out (T3-023, T3-095), the call to be represented (T3-033, T3-016), Sora's sheet, scattered calls and moving spots (T3-070, T3-049, T3-020), a solo drawing seen only by its maker (T3-016, T3-021), the Blue Corner's leave (T3-035, T3-002), a Keyblade found T3-082, small contributions shown and lost (T3-003, T3-029), building the Keyblade under erasure (T3-038, T3-005, T3-004), the Bills' agreement, Green Lattice permission and sparing Megaman and Stargate (T3-010, T3-035, T3-024; the truces and peace in c0150, c0158 and c0182 are not named in the note, left for B1d), shrinking to fit (T3-020, T3-069, T3-035), the small Keyblade claimed T3-009, a larger one on Discord T3-014, helpers redirected T3-069, r/placekeyblades as hub T3-013, a start inside the Linux penguin T3-020, an AutoModerator removal T3-063, K H and a heart added (T3-041, T3-004), patching and upkeep (T3-021, T3-005, T3-042), managing both pieces (T3-021, T3-070, T3-009), peace over a Darkness takeover (T3-076, T3-157, T3-150), the full Keyblade complete (T3-009, T3-005, T3-043), two pieces celebrated and the Packers thanked (T3-009, T3-003, T3-072), the Xion April Fools comic T3-001. Episodes: new E858 FinalFantasy (the sister subs' swap), E859 greenbaypackers (the heart in the Packers' script, its maker in both), E860 sips (the Keyblade under a planned spaceman, one builder in both). One-sided: madokamagica holds a Kingdom Hearts member's respect at h60.4 that this room does not tell; greenlattice and stargate hold nothing on this room. Leads: thebluecorner, buffalobills, linux, FlipnoteStudio3D (unread); placekeyblades and supernatural to be checked against the census. The E860 parse check ran in the same turn as its edit; it agreed with the record

One-sided: ice_poseidon and 2007scape hold no tree code. Leads: runescape, theblackvoid (unread); RuinTheTreePlace outside the census, to check.
